# Idle Toes

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark only.

![Idle Toes dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

- Colors: Idle Toes (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Idle Toes'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Idle%20Toes.yml).
- Default accent: cyan (#BED6FF); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Idle Toes`.

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme idle-toes
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme idle-toes
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme idle-toes` and `just switch-theme idle-toes` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).
